about_collection: Every item here comes from our festival or from Tamara Maksymenko, the leading artist of our company: festival merch, art objects, paintings, and costumes we sew ourselves.

All proceeds support the cultural association Motion Mode of Dialogue in Tyrol and its programs, including our work with artists and people from countries affected by war. We also contribute to other supporting organisations, but at the heart of everything is art.
With every piece you take home, you help our association exist, create, and keep bringing people together through art. Thank you! 🤍

products.description: Dance socks designed for contemporary and Contact Improvisation dancers. Good grip on the floor, comfortable through long jams, and made of natural material: 96% cotton, 4% elastane. One sock says “sock for contact”, the other “sock for solo”. Or take two pairs: wear “sock for solo” in your contemporary classes and “sock for contact” on both feet for Contact Improvisation.
products.delivery_info: Ground shipping to EU-countries — €8. You can choose shipping (with address) or free pickup in Innsbruck (Kaiserjägerstraße 42 - top 3) directly during Stripe Checkout.
